title: Litany of Trust Novena
description: A nine-day novena praying the Litany of Trust.

days.title: Day 1
days.body:
[[invocation]]In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.[[/invocation]]

[[plain]]Amen.[[/plain]]

[[heading]]The Litany of Trust[[/heading]]

[[plain]]From the belief that I have to earn Your love - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From the fear that I am unlovable - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From the false security that I have what it takes - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From the fear that trusting You will leave me more destitute - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From all suspicion of Your words and promises - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From the rebellion against childlike dependency on You - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From refusals and reluctances in accepting Your will - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From anxiety about the future - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From resentment or excessive preoccupation with the past - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From restless self-seeking in the present moment - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From disbelief in Your love and presence - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From the fear of being asked to give more than I have - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From the belief that my life has no meaning or worth - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From the fear of what love demands - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]From discouragement - Deliver me, Jesus.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That You are continually holding me, sustaining me, loving me - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That Your love goes deeper than my sins and failings and transforms me - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That not knowing what tomorrow brings is an invitation to lean on You - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That You are with me in my suffering - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That my suffering, united to Your own, will bear fruit in this life and the next - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That You will not leave me orphan, that You are present in Your Church - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That Your plan is better than anything else - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That You always hear me and in Your goodness always respond to me - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That You give me the grace to accept forgiveness and to forgive others - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That You give me all the strength I need for what is asked - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That my life is a gift - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That You will teach me to trust You - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That You are my Lord and my God - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[plain]]That I am Your beloved one - Jesus, I trust in You.[[/plain]]

[[italic]]That you will hear my prayers (mention your intentions here) - Jesus I trust in you.[[/italic]]

[[invocation]]In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.[[/invocation]]

[[plain]]Amen.[[/plain]]
